title: Hanen og høna i Nøtteskogen
placement: Each illustration belongs directly after the paragraph with index "paragraph" (0-based, paragraphs split on blank lines).

cover.caption: Hanen løper for å skaffe vann til Tuppe, høna si.
cover.alt: Hanen spurter mot oss langs stien i Nøtteskogen med vingene ut. Bak ham ligger høna i mosen under en hasselbusk og ser etter ham.
cover.prompt: In the Hazelwood on a bright morning, the Rooster races towards the viewer along the mossy path at full tilt, wings half spread and every feather streaming, a fierce, determined look in his eye. Behind him, under a hazel bush heavy with ripe nuts, the Hen lies in the moss among broken shells, watching him go. The path winds away between the bushes towards a sunny meadow.

characters.name: Hanen
characters.description: En rask og sta hane som nekter å gi opp før han har skaffet vann til høna si.
characters.look: A proud, sturdy farmyard rooster, snow-white all over with glossy white feathers, a big, floppy, bright scarlet comb and red wattles, a short yellow beak, round, earnest black eyes, strong yellow legs with spurs and a tall, arching tail of long white plumes. He carries himself upright with his chest puffed out, full of courage, and runs with his wings half spread.

characters.name: Tuppe (Høna)
characters.description: Høna som får et nøtteskall i halsen og trenger hjelp før det er for sent.
characters.look: A small, round, plump little hen, speckled grey all over with tiny white and charcoal flecks like salt and pepper, with a small neat red comb, a short pale beak, bright round orange eyes, soft fluffy grey feathers on her legs and little grey feet. She has a cheerful, curious, nut-loving look.

characters.name: Kilden
characters.description: En streng, men rettferdig kilde som bare gir vann når den får det den ber om.
characters.look: A small, round, crystal-clear spring welling up between mossy grey stones and splashing down into a little pool about as wide as a cartwheel, fringed with ferns and blue forget-me-nots. In its bubbling surface a face can just be seen in the ripples: two round, shining bubble eyes and a wide, gurgling mouth. The water is so clear that the pebbles on the bottom glint.

characters.name: Lindetreet
characters.description: Et stort lindetre som krever røde gullbånd før det vil gi fra seg løv.
characters.look: An enormous, ancient linden tree with a broad, rounded crown of heart-shaped leaves, green with the first touches of yellow, a thick, gnarled grey-brown trunk and big knobbly roots like toes. In the bark of the trunk is a kind, sleepy old face: two knot-hole eyes under mossy bark eyebrows, a round knobbly nose and a wide, gentle mouth, and two low branches bend like arms.

characters.name: Jomfru Maria
characters.description: En rolig skikkelse som kan gi røde gullbånd, men først vil ha sko.
characters.look: A small, soft, grandmotherly woman of about seventy with a round, kind, wrinkled face, twinkling light-grey eyes, a gentle smile and silver hair under a simple white linen veil. She wears a light-blue wool shawl over a plain, long lavender dress and goes barefoot. She looks like a humble country grandmother, with no halo and no crown.

characters.name: Kullbrenneren
characters.description: Den sotsvarte kullbrenneren inne i skogen. Han er den eneste som ikke vil ha noe tilbake, for han synes synd på hanen.
characters.look: A tall, lean, kindly man of about sixty, black with soot from his hood to his boots, so that only his friendly pale-blue eyes and a white-toothed smile shine out of a long, sooty face with a hooked nose and grey stubble. He wears a pointed grey wool hood over his head and shoulders, a long patched leather apron, sooty brown trousers and heavy boots.
